art.title: The Nautilus, in profile
art.creator: Ouro HX contributors
art.modifications: None: drawn for this site from Verne's text alone, not after any film or later design: no conning tower, sail or periscope, no fins, no riveted fish tail, no great eye-shaped window. Hull length to beam eight to one (232 by 26 feet), a spindle tapering to both ends; a long steel ram spur at the bow; a low platform on the back; on it, fore and aft, two low cages with lenticular glasses, the steersman's forward (a shallow dome) and the lantern's aft (broader, with a big lens, standing a little taller so the beam clears the other). Shaded as lit steel: a bright crown, the belly in shadow, the sea's light along the keel. Left out for clarity at this size: the long-boat, the platform's rail and the diving planes. Colours come from the theme (stage.css). Revised 2026-10-20 for S2: the cages drawn as Verne describes them, larger, so they read on a phone; then the steersman's cage lowered to a shallow dome so nothing on the back reads as a conning tower, the lantern made broader with a bigger lens, and the spur drawn in pale steel so it shows at the waterline.

art.title: The Nautilus, a shipwright's plan
art.creator: Ouro HX contributors
art.modifications: None: drawn for this site from Verne's text alone, to the same proportions as nautilus.svg and its construction sketch (nautilus-sketch.svg). A side plan in five parts the shipyard draws as each job is ticked: the double hull (two hulls joined by T-shaped irons, no rivets), the saloon's two oblong crystal panels bound in copper and the steersman's cage with lenticular glass, the engine room aft with its electric cells and magnets on the screw's axle, the lantern's cage aft on the platform, and the organ in the saloon. No tower, fins or eye-shaped window. Colours come from the theme (chapters.css).

art.title: The yard on the island
art.creator: Ouro HX contributors
art.modifications: None: drawn for this site from Verne's text alone as Chapter I's rail: the desert island where the Nautilus was put together (Twenty Thousand Leagues, ch. XII), a berth under two sheer-legs, and the same spindle hull as nautilus.svg in small, with its spur, low platform, lantern's cage, saloon windows and screw, plus a note for the organ. Each part is ghosted until its job is ticked; once launched she lies in the sea off the slip, and a pennant flies when you have signed on. No tower, fins or eye-shaped window. Colour comes from the theme (chapter-one.css).
